scripts.format: pnpm --filter @glazz/web exec prettier --write . && cd apps/api && gofmt -w .
scripts.contracts:lint: redocly lint packages/contracts/openapi.yaml packages/contracts/websocket.asyncapi.yaml && node scripts/validate-ws-fixtures.mjs && pnpm contracts:coverage
scripts.contracts:generate: openapi-typescript packages/contracts/openapi.yaml --output packages/contracts/generated/typescript/api.d.ts --immutable && cd apps/api && go generate ./internal/platform/api
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm go:format:check && pnpm go:lint && pnpm go:test && pnpm go:build && pnpm build
